payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_follow_up.py::test_the_next_spec_id_reads_both_spec_directories_and_the_repos_tasks stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'A file name pattern not anchored on the prefix.' applied to saffron/follow_up.py as an edit. The claim was "`follow_up.next_spec_id(origin_id, specs_dir, ledger, repo_id)` returns one more than the highest number carrying the origin id's prefix. It reads the `.md` file names in `specs_dir` and in its `done/`, and the spec ids of the repo's tasks. The number is zero-padded to the origin id's width. The witness makes each source the highest in turn. It holds a file of another prefix, a task of another repo, and an origin id of another width.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
